title: Fishhook
source_docs: Vehicle Dynamics Blockset/Vehicle Scenarios/Drive Cycle and Maneuvers/Fishhook.md
text: Generate commands to conduct fishhook maneuver, 2 inputs, 2 outputs; {Maneuver start time, tStart [s]} sets the start time, {Longitudinal velocity setpoint, velRef} sets the target velocity, {Longitudinal velocity setpoint units, velRefUnit []} sets the units, {Steer and countersteer speed, steerRate [deg/s]} sets the steer and countersteer rate, {Steer amplitude, steerAmp [deg]} sets the handwheel steer amplitude, {Use roll rate to determine initial steer dwell time} sets the option to use roll rate to determine initial steer dwell, {Initial dwell time, tDwellSteer [s]}, {Countersteer dwell time, tDwellCntrSteer [s]}, {Return to center time, tZero [s]} sets the time to return countersteer amplitude to zero, {Roll rate countersteer initiation zero crossing threshold, pZero [deg/s]} sets the roll rate tolerance and {Initial steer direction}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Steer and countersteer speed, steerRate [deg/s]
params.values: Steer and countersteer rate 720 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Use roll rate to determine initial steer dwell time
params.values: Option to use roll rate to determine initial steer dwell time off (default) | on

params.name: Return to center time, tZero [s]
params.values: Time to return countersteer amplitude to zero steer 2 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Roll rate countersteer initiation zero crossing threshold, pZero [deg/s]
